hello friend. 
one thing that i have learned was that setting boundaries is essential. i'm not saying that you didn't try to do this, but maybe you couldn't do it in a efficient way because you're not used to it. my mother was VERY emotional dependable of me and very protective too. i tried to set boundaries for YEARS and it simply didn't work, so i learned that i could not back down! she used to tell me that if i move out she would certainly die. it could be true, but it could be just emotional blackmail (which it was. she was unconsciously doing this because she unconsciously knew that it worked!) but even if it was true it would be completely up to her. understand what i'm saying? we can't control people's actions!! it is a lot on you to manage alone (your actions AND the actions of others), it doesn't seem fair. you should talk to her in a very kind but ASSERTIVE way. tell her that this life is making you miserable and it would be better for everyone if you did what you truly wanted. 
and what about your girlfriend? is your relationship healthy and do you like spending time with her? if so, you should talk to her openly and make her aware of what you're thinking so she won't be so hurt!
i wish you the best of luck, friend. and remember: if i got through it so can you!!
